notes.title: New armor and new appearances
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44608246/e7b82b325fe4845319ce746e76bc8a32ef845fee.jpg[/img][list][list]
[*] New armor has been added to the game. If you are lucky, you can get this armor by opening a chest. The armor turns the heroine into the Lightning Queen.
[*] Achievements have been added for each of the new skins: Lightning Queen, Storm Empress, Mistress of the Storm. They can be obtained by upgrading the skin to level 3.
[*] The game has changed the mechanics of jumping. As before, after jumping, the player cannot change the speed or direction of the jump. Now the player can turn around in a jump, which improves the gameplay.
[*] After completing the game, all the skins you have opened, purchased, or received are saved. Even if you start a new game or lose, they will remain available to you.
[/list]

notes.title: 03.11.2024 Quick Guide to the Game
notes.content:
[list]
[*] A quick guide to the game has been added. You can view it by clicking on the button in the main menu.
[*] Some levels have been slightly changed.
[*] NPCs have been added.
[/list]

notes.title: 12.10.2024 Mountain Trolls
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Several mountain trolls have appeared on the mountain level. They are slow, but their attack can knock you back.
[*] The blocking mechanics have been changed. Now, if you stand with your back to the enemy, the block does not work and you will take damage.
[*] Numbers with damage appear above the enemy when hit.
[/list]

notes.title: 27.09.2024 New armor and new appearances
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44608246/1b86ef03b6beac07b87feeb3877da3fe5924a492.jpg[/img][list]
[list]
[*] A new armor has been added to the game. If you are lucky, you can get this armor by opening a chest. The armor turns the heroine into a barbarian queen.
[*] For each of the new appearances, new achievements have been added - Queen of Barbarians, Princess of the Amazons, Azure warrior. You can get them by upgrading your appearance to level 3.
[*] There have been some technical changes in the game. Since these changes are quite significant, we decided to mention them. At the moment, the current version of the game is 1.8.
[/list]

notes.title: 13.09.2024 Shop changes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]The interface of the shop window has been changed. Now you can buy a key in the shop.
[*]Chests have appeared on some levels. The chest can be opened with a key.
[/list]

notes.title: 06.09.2024 Added leaderboards
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added leaderboards.
The game will now count the number of coins and gems collected in one game.
[*] Added new versions of enemies - skeleton commander and death knight.
[/list]

notes.title: 02.09.2024 continue game bug fix
notes.content: For some users, the button - continue game may not work. This is an unpleasant bug and it should be fixed in version 1.6.
